criteria.S1: every held-out environment: FP/host-hour <= 1 at alert (point estimate); <= 0.1 at high where the environment has >= 20 observed host-hours (otherwise the Poisson upper bound is reported)
criteria.S2: macro recall at alert over environments with attacks: model - rules paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0, and model - heuristic lower bound > -0.05
criteria.S3: leave-one-framework-out macro recall >= leave-one-technique-out macro recall - 0.15
criteria.S4: benign environment predictability (one-vs-rest, out-of-fold) macro ROC-AUC <= 0.70, and no top-30 feature present in only one environment's training rows
criteria.S5: each held-out mutation family: recall drop <= 0.10 on the attack rows it changes
criteria.S6: rebuild gives a bit-identical model.json; golden vectors match the pure-Python scorer

protocol.selection_rule: among CANDIDATES, those meeting S1's alert condition in every held-out environment; the highest macro recall at alert wins. If none meets it, the lowest worst-environment FP/host-hour at alert wins (and S1 fails)
protocol.decision_rule: shadow integration only if S1-S6 pass and the sealed final test passes (<= 1 FP/host-hour at alert)
